projects.name: VSS Live-Imaging Workflow
projects.description: Commercial imaging software added recurring cost, and the existing deployment path could carry problems from the old Windows installation into the new system. I built an in-house VSS live-imaging and delta-merging workflow that moved programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation instead.
highlights: The existing imaging process slowed endpoint deployment and could carry operating-system corruption into the replacement system.
Developed an in-house VSS live-imaging and delta-merging workflow that restored programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation.
Improved deployment stability by avoiding corruption carried forward from the previous Windows installation.
